static_traits.name: Zhang Taile
static_traits.social_status: Weak Social support system, difficulty discussing feelings of inadequacy with others; Avoiding photography-related social events due to Self-doubt
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems or treatment; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, high cooperativeness; capable of self-Reflection, emotions slightly Anxiety, and self-evaluation rather harsh

basic_info.main_problem: Because some photos have not achieved the Anticipation effect, I have always felt I am a terrible Photographer; a few months ago After receiving negative feedback, every time I take photos I doubt my ability.
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings of inadequacy have been hindering my creative process and passion for photography, affecting my overall well-being, so I hope to alleviate Self-doubt and rebuild confidence through counseling.
growth_experiences: A few months ago After receiving negative feedback on works, Persistent self-doubt began to appear: when reviewing photos or receiving others' feedback, always associating with 'I am not good enough', and gradually equating a few unsatisfactory works with overall inadequate ability, leading to Decline in creative motivation, project Procrastination and avoidance of shooting.

Had received praise for works in exhibitions many times, and a photography project completed last year obtained much positive feedback; these experiences once brought a sense of achievement and the experience of being seen, but recent negative feedback makes these positive memories seem distant.
Was Widowed at age 19, Living alone (specific details Not mentioned), weak Social support system, insufficient emotional support resources.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/I am a terrible Photographer
My worth depends on others' evaluations of my work

special_situations.event: Receiving negative feedback on one's work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my works are criticized, it proves my ability is insufficient and I will not succeed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces shooting, avoids occasions where they might be evaluated, or tries to improve quickly by taking online courses to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not capable, I am just a terrible Photographer.

special_situations.event: When reviewing photos, finding some works not yet reaching Anticipation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If some photos do not reach the perfect standard, it means my overall level is very poor
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinates on or avoids starting new projects, repeatedly checks and picks at her own work
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These photos are not good, it shows I have no talent.

special_situations.event: Thinking of or facing photography-related social/exhibition settings where one may be evaluated by others
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot satisfy others, it shows I am not worthy of recognition
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids photography social events, reduces interaction with peers to avoid being compared and judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think my level is very poor, will look down on me.

special_situations.event: Recalls praise once received at exhibitions or projects
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive feedback is unreliable or unrepresentative, only the negative is real
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating and belittling positive evaluations, continuously raising standards to maintain 'vigilance'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Those praises do not count, it is just good luck.

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized, to have one's value and ability as a Photographer seen
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated and humiliated, worrying that failure means self-worth is completely overturned
defense_goal: By avoiding situations where one is evaluated to reduce the risk of being negated
Gains a sense of control through self-criticism and excessive self-demands

object_relations.self_representation: A performer who needs to please others
object_relations.object_representation: Others/groups who must be pleased and satisfied

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor guides one to recall positive feedback and successful experiences
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: believes those successes are unrepresentative, cannot indicate overall ability
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplay positive evidence in a gentle but negating tone, for example 'that is just good luck', and give seemingly objective reasons to weaken the success.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing others' feedback or potential evaluation scenarios
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Externalizing the inner self-criticism experience, assuming others will completely negate oneself
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use speculative language to emphasize others' negative views (such as 'They will think I am terrible'), and accordingly express the wish to Withdraw.

manifestations: Widowed and Living alone, lacking a strong Social support system
Avoids photography-related social activities, reducing contact with peers
Self-doubt eroding creative passion, tying self-worth excessively to external evaluation
Declining interest in and dedication to photography

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequently engaging in Self-denial when reviewing photos ('I am not good enough' 'I will never succeed')
Cautiously Withdrawing due to fear of being evaluated, Reduced socializing and exposure

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Assuming others will look down on one's works, tending to assume negative evaluations in social situations
Based on guesses about others' thoughts, Avoids communication

exception_events.target_problem: When reviewing works or facing others' evaluations, Zhang Taile usually equates a few unsatisfactory photos with overall inadequate ability, thus doubting himself, avoiding continuing to create, leading to project delays.
exception_events.unique_outcome: A photography project completed last year received much praise; he experienced achievement and being seen during the creative process, significantly less than the usual Self-doubt.
exception_events.reason: Different support: positive feedback from audiences/peers; different understanding and context: the project matched his strong suit of the 'emotion and story' theme, high engagement, focused on expression rather than pleasing others.

exception_events.target_problem: In photography Social situations, Zhang Taile often chooses to Withdraw due to fear of being evaluated, thus reducing exposure and interaction opportunities.
exception_events.unique_outcome: At multiple exhibitions, his works received praise from the audience and peers; at that time he could feel gratified and confident, rather than belittling himself across the board.
exception_events.reason: Different context: the exhibition atmosphere was more inclusive, non-judgmental; different support: positive on-site feedback reduced the Anticipation of being negated.

positive_force: Passion and strengths in photography for capturing emotion and stories
Past successful experiences (exhibition praise, good reviews on annual projects) provide evidence of real ability
Actively seeking help and Learning (online courses, willing to engage in counseling), possesses Reflection ability
Able to accept feedback and restructure cognitions under structured methods
negative_force: Overgeneralization, negating the positive, mind reading and other cognitive biases maintain Self-doubt
Over-relies on external evaluation (External Validation) to define self-worth
The behavioral pattern of avoiding filming and socializing reduces positive feedback and growth opportunities
Weak social support system and Loneliness exacerbate negative emotions and Decreased drive
Black-and-white thinking and high standards cause constant pressure

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding filming new works and project procrastination
antecedent: Reviewing photos and finding some unsatisfactory
When preparing to take on a client shoot, associates it with possible failure
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing a few unsatisfactory performances and overgeneralizing them as inadequate ability, fearing failure and being negated
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential shame and negative evaluation, temporarily relieving Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: The project is delayed, the creative process is obstructed, and confidence drops further

antecedent: Needs to attend exhibitions, peer gatherings, or work-sharing sessions
target_behavior.core_reason: Mind reading and external-validation tendency, assuming others will negate oneself
target_behavior.function: Avoiding Social anxiety and the discomfort of being judged
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced Social support and positive feedback, Loneliness and Intensifying self-doubt

target_behavior.behavior: Negative self-statements of repeated self-deprecation during photo review
target_behavior.core_reason: the inner belief 'I am not good enough', accompanied by cognitive biases of mental filtering and negating the positive
target_behavior.function: Maintains a negative schema about her own abilities, gaining a surface sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood, Decreased motivation, further Reinforcement of avoidance and procrastination
